name: Bhutan

fees.name: Tourist visa (online application via Department of Immigration portal)
fees.validity: Single visa covering approved stay; processed within 5 working days
fees.applies: all nationalities except India, Bangladesh and Maldives
fees.notes: One-time, non-refundable USD 40 application fee. Applied online at https://immi.gov.bt/ or via a licensed tour operator. Separate from the mandatory Sustainable Development Fee (SDF) of USD 100 per adult per night (USD 50 for children 6-11, free under 6), payable with the visa application. Bhutan issues no embassy sticker visas for tourism; all tourist visas are processed online. Bhutan is not a Schengen member.

fees.name: Entry permit for Indian nationals (visa-free, permit at entry or online)
fees.notes: Indian nationals need no visa; an entry permit is issued with no advance fee (passport with 6 months validity or voter ID). They must pay SDF of INR 1,200 per person per night (children 5 and under exempt; 6-12 pay 50%). Day visits (under 24h) to border towns Phuentsholing, Samtse, Gelephu and Samdrup Jongkhar are SDF-exempt.

fees.name: Entry arrangements for Bangladesh and Maldives nationals
fees.notes: Nationals of Bangladesh and the Maldives are exempt from the standard USD 40 visa fee regime under bilateral arrangements; exact permit/visa fee (if any) not published with a specific amount on the official portal, so amount left null rather than estimated. SDF rules for these nationalities are set by government notification.

reciprocity_variations.note: Visa-free; entry permit with no advance fee, but SDF of INR 1,200 per night applies instead of the USD 100 SDF charged to other nationalities.

free_visa_notes: Not free for most nationalities: USD 40 online visa fee plus mandatory SDF of USD 100/adult/night. Indian nationals enter visa-free on a no-fee permit but pay SDF of INR 1,200/night. There is no separate embassy sticker visa, visa-on-arrival fee (for the general public), eTA, business or transit visa fee schedule published; all entries go through the Department of Immigration online system (immi.gov.bt).
